summary_1line: At dawn the battle resumes; Arjuna devastates foes while Drona rampages, killing Drupada’s grandsons and overpowering allied kings.

image_candidates.scene_text: Warriors from both armies stand beside their chariots at sunrise, hands joined in prayer as the red sun rises over the battlefield.
Amid a choking cloud of dust and arrows, Arjuna’s chariot surges forward while shafts streak in every direction and warriors fight blindly.
Drona stands blazing like a smokeless fire on the field as kings rush him from all sides and the bodies of fallen princes lie nearby.
